summary: First Northwest Bancorp filed an 8-K on September 18, 2026, disclosing that its subsidiary First Fed Bank settled litigation brought by Socotra REIT I, LLC. The complaint, filed October 17, 2025, in King County Superior Court, alleged misrepresentation, fraud, conversion, and Washington Consumer Protection Act violations tied to a commercial loan involving Ideal Property Investments LLC. Under the September 15, 2026 Settlement Agreement and Mutual Release, the Bank will pay $1.3 million cash within 30 days for a full release and dismissal with prejudice. This is a routine litigation settlement, not a special situation.
